sources.snippet: Overview Dolphin3-Cyber-8B-GGUF is a cybersecurity-specialized 8-billion parameter language model built on the Llama 3.1 architecture and fine-tuned exclusively for offensive security, defensive security, vulnerability research, and exploit development.
